info.title: Commerce_App HTTP API
info.description: Current local NestJS services: health, registration, verified-only account sessions and password-bound email verification through local captured email. Password recovery, external email and public deployment remain deferred. Browser account pages use these APIs directly. Application responses retain server correlation and nosniff; account/verification/error responses are no-store. JSON defaults to 1 MiB; compressed bodies are unsupported. Lower-level parser failures can be non-JSON. See docs/api/README.md and linked service guides for limits and operational behavior.

servers.description: Local API default; substitute the configured API_PORT in your client.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: Ordinary registration, verified-only sessions and local email verification.

get.description: Independent of PostgreSQL and registration admission. No request body is needed. Remains live while the process can serve requests.

200.description: HTTP process is live; database availability is irrelevant.

get.description: Fresh database probe with at most a two-second deadline including pool acquisition. Overlapping requests coalesce one active probe; completed results are not cached for later requests. Shutdown makes readiness unavailable. This does not establish account schema availability. Unexpected thrown failures use the generic 500 envelope.

200.description: Database probe succeeded and shutdown has not begun. This does not check account schema or migration state.

503.description: Database probe failed/timed out or shutdown began. This status-only body does not carry Retry-After.

post.description: Exactly email/password strings; unknown properties fail before email/password validation. Creates an unverified ordinary account and credential atomically if canonical email is absent; duplicates never replace credentials or timestamps. New and existing valid addresses both hash and return the same exact 202, without account IDs, existence flags, Location, cookie, token or email-delivery claim. SQL/network timing is not guaranteed constant. Five parsed attempts per direct socket peer per 60-second fixed window per process, at most 1024 live peer buckets; forwarded identity ignored. Field-invalid attempts consume peer budget; parser failures do not. Admission can return 429 before validation. After validation, at most two hash/persistence operations run, with no queue; saturation returns 503. A disconnect does not cancel admitted work. Restart resets peer limits; replicas multiply them. A newly committed account triggers a bounded initial local verification attempt. Post-commit challenge/mail failure preserves this acknowledgment without claiming delivery. Duplicate registration sends no message and never changes credentials; use the dedicated verification-request endpoint to resend.

requestBody.description: An uncompressed application/json object containing only email and password. Header charset parameters are supported.

202.description: Request processing succeeded for a new or existing canonical email. This does not confirm creation, verification, email delivery or sign-in.

400.description: Input shape/email/password policy failure, or an earlier JSON parser failure. Field/code exist only on validation errors.

post.description: Only verified accounts may sign in. Correct credentials for an unverified account return verification_required 403 without a cookie or automatic email. Unknown accounts and wrong passwords share generic 401. Five parsed attempts per direct peer per 60 seconds with 1024 buckets; registration, sign-in and confirmation share two password-work slots. Custom header and trusted exact Origin are required as documented.

parameters.name: X-Commerce-Request
parameters.description: Must equal 1; required on every session endpoint.

email.description: Same canonical email identity as registration.

password.description: Well-formed Unicode, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, normalized to NFC. Existing credentials are verified without reapplying registration password policy.

Set-Cookie.description: Host-only session cookie with Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and Path=/.

403.description: Untrusted origin/missing header, or correct credentials that require verification.

get.description: Expires after 30 minutes of inactivity or 12 hours after issuance, whichever comes first. Requires the custom header and allowed Origin when present. Inspection also requires the linked account to remain verified. Pre-verification sessions are permanently revoked during rollout/confirmation and cannot regain validity after verification.

parameters.description: Must equal 1; required on every session endpoint.

403.description: Untrusted origin or missing request header.

delete.description: Revokes only the presented session and clears the cookie. Returns 503 if revocation cannot be determined.

parameters.name: X-Commerce-Request
parameters.description: Must equal 1; required on every session endpoint.

Set-Cookie.description: Host-only session cookie with Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and Path=/.

403.description: Untrusted origin or missing request header.

post.description: Anonymous, non-credentialed JSON request. Unknown, verified and suppressed addresses share 202; no account is created and no delivery is promised. Eligible unverified accounts get a best-effort captured-mail attempt. One issuance per account per 60 seconds, three retained challenges, 30-minute expiry. Five parsed attempts per peer per 60 seconds, 1024 peer buckets; two issuance/delivery slots with no queue and five-second SMTP deadline. SMTP failures after persistence do not change 202; database failures during required work return 503, unexpected failures 500. No automatic retry, durable delivery, cookie or credential output. CORS permits Content-Type and X-Commerce-Request only for trusted origins, without credential grants. 429 Retry-After is a positive integer; saturation 503 has Retry-After 1. Operational guide: docs/email-verification.md.

parameters.name: X-Commerce-Request
parameters.description: Must equal 1; required on every session and verification endpoint. A present Origin must exactly match WEB_ORIGINS.

email.description: Registration canonicalization: trim outer ASCII space/tab, lowercase ASCII dot-atom email; at most 254 canonical bytes. Raw input at most 1024 bytes.

202.description: Request processed without revealing existence, verification state or delivery.

403.description: Untrusted Origin or missing custom header; rejected before account work.

post.summary: Confirm email with the registered password
post.description: Anonymous, non-credentialed JSON request. A live single-use 30-minute token and matching registered password atomically set the verification timestamp, invalidate all sibling challenges and revoke all extant account sessions. No password replacement or automatic sign-in. Unknown/expired/used tokens, verified accounts and wrong passwords share 401. Malformed input returns 400; well-formed eligible attempts use real/dummy password work at the existing bounded cost. Five attempts per direct peer per 60 seconds with 1024 buckets; shares two password-work slots with registration/sign-in. No mutation occurs from GET, preview or link opening. A timeout can follow a committed confirmation; a consumed-link retry is not proof of failure. Custom header, exact Origin, CORS and redaction follow the request endpoint. Operational guide: docs/email-verification.md.

parameters.name: X-Commerce-Request
parameters.description: Must equal 1; required on every session and verification endpoint. A present Origin must exactly match WEB_ORIGINS.

token.description: Canonical base64url encoding of the emailed 32-byte secret. Send only in JSON, never in an API URL.

password.description: Well-formed Unicode, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, normalized to NFC. Existing credentials are verified without reapplying registration password policy.

200.description: Verified; explicitly sign in afterward. No Set-Cookie.

401.description: Token/password confirmation rejected without revealing which proof failed.

403.description: Untrusted Origin or missing custom header; rejected before account work.

RequestId.description: Server-generated correlation UUID. Caller IDs are not trusted.

RetrySeconds.description: Positive integer delay in seconds until this peer's window or the earliest live-peer bucket expires.

RetryOne.description: Retry delay in seconds; fixed at 1 for generic 503.

email.description: Raw ASCII input <=1024 UTF-8 bytes. Trim only outer SP/HTAB and lowercase entire address. Canonical address <=254 bytes; dot-atom local part <=64 bytes; domain has >=2 labels of 1-63 alphanumeric/hyphen characters with alphanumeric ends. Reject controls, internal whitespace, Unicode, quoted local parts, domain literals and trailing domain dot. Dots/+ suffixes preserved; no DNS/provider rewrite. Deliberately no raw JSON Schema email format: outer space/tab is accepted and normalization precedes syntax validation.

password.description: Well-formed Unicode, <=1024 raw UTF-8 bytes; NFC normalization then 15-128 Unicode code points. No trimming, truncation or composition rules; spaces and case are significant. Whole NFC/lowercase matches against the pinned local common-password corpus, submitted canonical email/local part, commerceapp12345, commerce_app12345 and commerce-app12345 are rejected. Screening folds case, hashing preserves it. Raw minLength/maxLength are deliberately omitted: pre-normalization schema lengths would misrepresent the normalized server policy.

BadJson.description: Malformed JSON, invalid JSON body encoding or parser rejection before route validation.

UnsupportedMedia.description: A body uses unsupported media or content encoding. Only uncompressed application/json is supported.

RateLimited.description: Direct-peer fixed-window limit or live-peer map capacity reached; no hash/persistence work. Retry-After is a positive integer number of seconds.

Unavailable.description: Hash/persistence saturation, shutdown, or recognized temporary database failure/timeout/missing required account schema. No acceptance is claimed.

InternalError.description: Unexpected failure; raw exception and infrastructure details are withheld.
